cases.title: Поля через запятую
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return $elem/id, $elem/fullname, $elem/position_name

cases.title: Fields() с именами полей
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return $elem/Fields(id, fullname, position_name)

cases.title: Fields() со строковыми именами полей
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname', 'position_name')

cases.title: Псевдонимы полей
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return $elem/id collaborator_id, $elem/fullname collaborator_name

cases.title: Псевдонимы внутри Fields()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return $elem/Fields(id collaborator_id, fullname collaborator_name)

cases.title: Возврат всей записи
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem

cases.title: Числовой параметр
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Число не равно
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id != 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Число больше
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id > 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Число больше или равно
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id >= 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Число меньше
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id < 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Число меньше или равно
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/id <= 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Строковый параметр
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/code = '13744' return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Поиск подстроки через contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where contains($elem/fullname, 'Анисимов') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Отрицание contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where contains($elem/fullname, 'Анисимов') = false() return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Знак процента в contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where contains($elem/fullname, '%') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Подчёркивание в contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where contains($elem/fullname, '_') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Открывающая скобка в contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where contains($elem/fullname, '[') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Булево значение
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/is_dismiss = false() return $elem/Fields('id', 'is_dismiss')

cases.title: Равенство true()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/is_dismiss = true() return $elem/Fields('id', 'is_dismiss')

cases.title: Не равно false()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/is_dismiss != false() return $elem/Fields('id', 'is_dismiss')

cases.title: Не равно true()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/is_dismiss != true() return $elem/Fields('id', 'is_dismiss')

cases.title: Сравнение с null()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/position_id = null() return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_id')

cases.title: Не равно null()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/position_id != null() return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_id')

cases.title: Сравнение с пустой строкой
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/code = '' return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Не равно пустой строке
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/code != '' return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Дата через date()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/hire_date = date('2010-03-17') return $elem/Fields('id', 'hire_date')

cases.title: Диапазон дат
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/hire_date >= date('2010-03-01') and $elem/hire_date < date('2010-04-01') return $elem/Fields('id', 'hire_date')

cases.title: Проверка IsEmpty()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where IsEmpty($elem/birth_date) = true() return $elem/Fields('id', 'birth_date')

cases.title: IsEmpty() равно false()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where IsEmpty($elem/birth_date) = false() return $elem/Fields('id', 'birth_date')

cases.title: IsEmpty() не равно true()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where IsEmpty($elem/birth_date) != true() return $elem/Fields('id', 'birth_date')

cases.title: Группировка and/or скобками
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where ($elem/is_dismiss = false() and contains($elem/fullname, 'Анисимов')) or $elem/id = 1105387902724063521 return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Два каталога в for
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators, $pos in positions where $elem/position_id = $pos/id and $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem/id, $elem/fullname, $pos/name position_name

cases.title: Связь через some/satisfies
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where some $pos in positions satisfies ($elem/position_id = $pos/id) and $pos/name = 'Руководитель отдела обучения и развития' return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_name')

cases.title: Три каталога через some/satisfies
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where some $app in appointment_types satisfies ($pos/position_appointment_type_id = $app/id) and some $pos in positions satisfies ($elem/position_id = $pos/id) and $app/code = 'main' return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_name')

cases.title: Явный join/on
cases.xQuery: for $pos in positions join $elem in collaborators on $elem/position_id = $pos/id where $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id') $pos/Fields('name')

cases.title: Явный ljoin/on
cases.xQuery: for $pos in positions ljoin $elem in collaborators on $elem/position_id = $pos/id where $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id') $pos/Fields('name')

cases.title: Явный rjoin/on
cases.xQuery: for $pos in positions rjoin $elem in collaborators on $elem/position_id = $pos/id where $elem/id = 1105387902724063510 return $elem/Fields('id') $pos/Fields('name')

cases.title: MatchSome()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: MatchSome() для множественного поля
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/category_id, (6756124991377782860, 6971009037900419123)) return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname', 'category_id')

cases.title: Отрицание MatchSome()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) = false() return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Отрицание MatchSome() оператором not
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where not MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Отрицание MatchSome() через not()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where not(MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295'))) return $elem/Fields('id', 'code')

cases.title: Исключение через ljoin() и MatchSome()
cases.xQuery: for $excluded in collaborators ljoin $elem in collaborators on $elem/id = $excluded/id and MatchSome($excluded/code, ('13744', '109295')) where $excluded/id = null() return $elem/Fields('id')

cases.title: ForeignElem()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where ForeignElem($elem/position_id)/name = 'Бизнес-тренер' return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_id')

cases.title: ForeignDispName в условии
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where $elem/position_id/ForeignDispName = 'Бизнес-тренер' return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_id')

cases.title: ForeignDispName в сортировке
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) order by $elem/position_id/ForeignDispName return $elem/Fields('id', 'position_id')

cases.title: Полнотекстовый doc-contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where doc-contains($elem/id, '', 'Анисимов') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Равенство кастомного поля в doc-contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where doc-contains($elem/id, '', '[f_zsbu = зеленый]') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Подстрока кастомного поля в doc-contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where doc-contains($elem/id, '', '[f_zsbu contains зелен]') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Булево кастомное поле в doc-contains()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where doc-contains($elem/id, '', '[is_universal = true~bool]') return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: IsHierChild() без Hier()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where IsHierChild($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: IsHierChildOrSelf() без Hier()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where IsHierChildOrSelf($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: Условие после IsHierChild()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where IsHierChild($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) and $elem/is_disbanded = false() order by $elem/Hier() return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: Условие перед IsHierChild()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where $elem/is_disbanded = false() and IsHierChild($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) order by $elem/Hier() return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: IsHierChild()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where IsHierChild($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) order by $elem/Hier() return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: IsHierChildOrSelf()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in subdivisions where IsHierChildOrSelf($elem/id, 6327975429225669221) order by $elem/Hier() return $elem/Fields('id', 'name')

cases.title: CatalogHierSubset()
cases.xQuery: CatalogHierSubset('subdivisions', 6327975429225669221)

cases.title: Уникальные ФИО через distinct()
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators return distinct($elem/fullname)

cases.title: Явная сортировка по возрастанию
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) order by $elem/fullname return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')

cases.title: Явная сортировка по убыванию
cases.xQuery: for $elem in collaborators where MatchSome($elem/code, ('13744', '109295')) order by $elem/fullname descending return $elem/Fields('id', 'fullname')
